name: Jitters
summary: Jitters is a trembling, reclusive human hiding out among the ruins of Raven Hill in western Duskwood. Though he appears to be merely an eccentric coward starving in the dark, he is secretly tied to the tragic sequence of events that brought ravenous worgen and deadly Dark Riders into the region.

sections.title: A Haunted Hermit
sections.body: Found shivering amid the dilapidated houses of Raven Hill, Jitters lives in constant terror of the predators stalking Duskwood's western trails. He relies on passing adventurers for simple sustenance, desperate for food while keeping a frantic eye on the encroaching shadows. His skittish mannerisms and uncanny reflex for leaping clear of sudden danger earned him his moniker long ago, but his frantic paranoia is born from firsthand encounters with horrific horrors.

sections.title: The Awakening at Roland's Doom
sections.body: Jitters was originally affiliated with the Defias Brotherhood as they moved into Duskwood. While digging at the mine known as Roland's Doom, he uncovered the Scythe of Elune protruding from the rock. The artifact unleashed ferocious, bloodthirsty worgen into the woods. Jitters watched in horror as his comrades were torn to pieces, barely escaping the slaughter with his own skin intact.

sections.title: Flight and the Farmstead
sections.body: Fleeing the mine, Jitters retreated to Darkshire, purchasing a blank tome from Clerk Daltry and feverishly chronicling the nightmare while hiding at the Scarlet Raven Tavern. Panicked, he took refuge in a barn at the Yorgen Farmstead. There, he witnessed black-cloaked Dark Riders butchering Sven Yorgen's family in search of the Scythe. Terrified of being blamed or found, Jitters buried pages of his journal in the soil and fled to Raven Hill, pursued by crippling guilt and ceaseless dread.

faq.answer: Jitters is a frightened human surviving alone among the abandoned buildings of Raven Hill in Duskwood. Once involved with the Defias Brotherhood, he is now a desperate vagrant tormented by the disasters he inadvertently set in motion.

aliases: where did his name come from
faq.answer: His nickname originated from his cautious nature, specifically his instinctive habit of flinching away from strikes and leaping clear of sudden pitfalls. His prolonged isolation and sheer terror in Duskwood have only made his nervousness worse.

faq.q: How did the worgen get into Duskwood?
faq.answer: While exploring the mine at Roland's Doom, Jitters unearthed the Scythe of Elune lodged in the stone. Disturbance of the cursed artifact allowed savage worgen to cross into Duskwood, instantly butchering Jitters' companions and spreading across the forest.

faq.q: What happened to Sven Yorgen's family?
faq.answer: Ominous figures known as the Dark Riders attacked the farmstead while hunting for the Scythe of Elune. Jitters was hiding in the barn at the time and witnessed the slaughter of Sven's wife and children, but was too terrified to intervene.

faq.q: Why is Sven Yorgen angry with Jitters?
faq.answer: When Sven returned to find his family murdered, he caught sight of Jitters frantically burying a journal near the property before fleeing into the woods. Sven initially suspected Jitters of having a hand in the tragedy or hiding knowledge of the killers.

After escaping Roland's Doom, Jitters bought a blank book from Clerk Daltry in Darkshire and spent nights at the Scarlet Raven Tavern writing down the events surrounding the Scythe of Elune, the worgen, and the Dark Riders. Parts of this journal were later buried at the Yorgen Farmstead.

angles.text: Jitters represents the human face of Duskwood's tragedy—a man whose misguided curiosity shattered the fragile safety of the realm and left the Night Watch fighting a desperate war against beasts and riders.
Before his terror took hold, Jitters put his quick instincts to work alongside the Defias Brotherhood during their covert infiltration of the southern territories.
The artifact Jitters disturbed at Roland's Doom bears the name of the moon goddess Elune, hinting at sacred Kaldorei magic that has been twisted into a feral nightmare.
